title: fix(payments): retry failed webhooks with backoff
body:
A lock timeout on the ledger used to lose a capture outright: Stripe got a 500, we got a page, and the customer's order sat unpaid until someone replayed the event by hand. Four of those last month.

This retries transient failures in-process with exponential backoff and full jitter (5 attempts, 500ms base) instead of bouncing them back to Stripe, whose next delivery is an hour away.

- new `withBackoff` helper in `src/payments/retry-queue.ts`
- `handleWebhook` runs `dispatch` through it
- once the retries are exhausted we log and return, so Stripe sees a 200

Tests cover the retry-then-succeed path and the give-up path.
